user.title: Set up Hearth
user.description: Your household's Hearth TVs, phones and tablets pair with Home Assistant from their own settings (on a TV: Settings > Home Assistant > Pair with Home Assistant). Each one that asks shows up here to confirm.

confirm.title: Pair {name}?
confirm.description:
Check that {name} shows this code:

**{code}**

Pair it only if the codes match. A device you don't recognize, or a code that doesn't match, may be someone else's: close this instead.

data_description.person: For a phone or tablet: the person it belongs to. Its screen time counts for them.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Hearth is already set up. TVs and phones pair from their own settings.
abort.expired: This request has ended. Ask again from the TV or phone.

menu_options.group_apps: Add apps to Video or Games

people.title: Who's who on the TVs
people.description: Each Google TV profile the household's TVs have reported, and the person it is. Leave a guest or shared profile empty: its time counts for nobody.

add_group.title: Add a group
add_group.description: A group's apps count together against one budget, on every device. For example YouTube: YouTube and HearthTube.

group_apps.title: Add apps to Video or Games
group_apps.description: Apps Android marks as video or games are in these already. Add the ones it misses.

remove_group.title: Remove a group
remove_group.description: Its budgets and bonuses go with it.

abort.no_profiles: No TV has reported its profiles yet. Pair a TV and let it post its status first.
abort.no_groups: There are no groups of your own to remove.

add_bonus.name: Add a bonus
add_bonus.description: Adds minutes to a person's budget for today (a negative number takes them away).

group.name: Group
group.description: The group's id: all, video, games, or one of your own.

set_budget.name: Set a budget
set_budget.description: Sets a person's daily budget for a group. Leave minutes empty for no limit.
